notes: Known-ledger rows for internal/server were excluded (NIT-38 time.DateOnly variant in bootstrap.go:175, statErr/gitErr naming in repos.go treated as pervasive legacy xxxErr pattern). Cross-chunk: none found that needs another chunk.

findings.claim: New method handleSessionsArchiveTab is inserted after handleSessionsBatch, breaking the otherwise alphabetical order of the Server handler methods in sessions.go (ArchiveTab sorts before Batch).
findings.evidence: Re-read sessions.go 75-211: order is handleSessionsBatch(75), handleSessionsArchiveTab(127), handleSessionsIndex(142), handleSessionsScope(154), handleSessionsScopeArchive(177), ScopeDelete(186), ScopeUnarchive(195), reloadSessions(207) — every other method is alphabetical; base version was Batch, Index, Reload, Scope (alphabetical). Only the new ArchiveTab is out of place.

findings.claim: The new expandMarkers predicate (revert && target != catalog.TargetCodex) is exactly the negation of the existing guard at line 70 (!revert || target == catalog.TargetCodex); the same 'claude revert' condition is now spelled twice in one function, so a change to one (e.g. enabling codex markers) silently desyncs the parked-state clearing.
findings.evidence: Re-read config_sync.go 37-82: line 50 expandMarkers := revert && target != catalog.TargetCodex; line 70 if !revert || target == catalog.TargetCodex { return output, nil } — De Morgan of line 50. Both live in handleConfigSyncOp, line 70 inside the op closure that already captures expandMarkers.
findings.fix: Name the predicate once (isClaudeRevert := revert && target != catalog.TargetCodex), pass it to copyFileAtomic and use if !isClaudeRevert at line 70.

findings.claim: TestServer_HandleProfileSave repeats the identical five-line dir/newTestServer(PresentationPath, StylePath, SyncScriptsDir) construction six times (and TestServer_HandleProfileStyleSave twice more), where the package's other test files factor such setup into a helper (reposTestEnv, newVoteServer, newGroupTitlesServer).
findings.evidence: Re-read profilesettings_test.go 50-148 and 174-196: blocks at 53-58, 69-74, 85-90, 102-107, 119-124, 135-140 are byte-identical apart from dir reassignment; 177-181 and 192-196 repeat the first two options. repos_test.go:25 reposTestEnv and proposals_test.go:480 newVoteServer show the in-package helper pattern.
findings.fix: Add newProfileServer(t) returning a server with temp presentation/style paths and a stub sync script, and call it in each case block.

findings.claim: The new audience-gated snippet summary ({{if isDeveloperAudience}}{{.Kind}}… · from {{.Source}}{{else}}{{t "technical detail"}}{{end}}) is copied verbatim into _session_list.html:35 and _proposal_card.html:81, so the casual/developer snippet label now has two sources to keep in sync.
findings.evidence: Re-read _session_list.html 33-38 and _proposal_card.html 79-84: both <summary> lines are character-identical, both introduced by this diff (template diff hunks @@ -4,35 and @@ -73,7).
findings.fix: Extract a {{define "_snippet.html"}} partial for the <details class="snippet"> block and include it from both templates.

findings.claim: The new Worktrees cell carries class="wt-kinds", but no stylesheet rule or script references wt-kinds — a dead class attribute.
findings.evidence: git grep wt-kinds over internal/ and cmd/ returns only repos_index.html:48; style.css (read in full, 710 lines) has no .wt-kinds rule and repos_index.html has no script.
findings.fix: Drop class="wt-kinds" or add the intended .wt-kinds rule to style.css.

findings.claim: The cmd.Start failure is wrapped as "Failed to start claude", but the command started is bash running cmd/bootstrap/run.sh, so a missing/unexecutable bash or wrapper reports a misleading context.
findings.evidence: Re-read bootstrap.go 80-92: cmd := exec.CommandContext(runCtx, bashPath, "-c", script, "bash", filepath.Join("cmd", "bootstrap", "run.sh")); line 90 fmt.Errorf("handleWelcomeBootstrap: Failed to start claude: %w", err). claude is only resolved later inside the wrapper.
findings.fix: Change the message to "handleWelcomeBootstrap: Failed to start the bootstrap wrapper: %w".
